latest_scientific_finding.summary: The tested fixed conditional N1 architecture is not a universal synthetic rescue for PL misspecification. Best-PL KL increased 28.2% from W0-W1 to W2-W4, but N1 was 4.7% worse than best-PL on aggregate W2-W4. N1 was best only in W2; C0_SCORE_PL was best in W0, W1, W3, and W4.
